content:
rachel (finance): FYI: on 2026-06-01 UTC we'll change metering attribution for short bursts to minute-level buckets. This is an attribution change only — no unit price changes.

ben (billing): Short summary: invoices will surface `minute_bucket_ts` for high-velocity minutes. Rate limits still use a 60-minute smoothing window for throttling.

kai (ops): Why: short spikes were averaged out and caused confusing invoices. Minute buckets make cost signals accurate and enable minute-aware routing for Dedicated.

tess (support): Quick support reply: 'We now attribute usage to the minute it occurred; spikes can appear. We can review or enable legacy smoothing temporarily.'

ben (billing): Dev note: metering events will emit `minute_bucket_ts` and `burst_flag`. CSV export example: customer_id,minute_bucket_ts,tokens,route,model,unit_price_usd.

metering-bot: deploy:billing-meter v2.14 promoted at 2185900100 — minute_bucket_ts ON.

rachel (finance): Rollout: blog 2026-05-05, console banner 2026-05-10, emails 2026-05-12. Opt-out: 90-day console/API toggle for legacy daily smoothing. File regressions in #eng-releases and tag `billing-meter` + `priority:high`.
